single.rationale: GeneDx shows exceptional operational momentum with 40% revenue growth, inflection to positive operating cash flow ($33M), expanding gross margins (70%), and near-breakeven operations despite continued losses. The company possesses strategic assets (2.5M+ test dataset, 50% non-European diversity) in a market transitioning from panels to exome/genome sequencing, though reimbursement uncertainty and competition remain material risks.
